text:
[LCCO.3.4] **A generated correlation is per activation, not per call
site.** Each firing of a `call` with no `as`, or whose `as` evaluates to `""`
([LRST.1.2]), gets its own value ([LCRS.3.1]), of the form `$<outer_rule_name>_c<N>_<u>`, where `<outer_rule_name>`
is the name of the rule that issues the call, `<N>` is the source-order index of
the `call` action among the calls of that rule's own body, counting every call
whatever its `as` (zero for the first), and `<u>` is `g<k>`, the value the
firing takes from the engine's correlation counter ([LCCO.3.7]).

A call in an `after` body or a continuation body is issued by the synthesized
rule that runs that body ([RLOW.14.7]), not by the authored rule: its
`<outer_rule_name>` is that rule's name, `$<rule>_after_<N>` ([LTAC.8.1]) or
`$<outer>_<kind>_<N>` ([LCCO.4.1]), and its `<N>` counts the calls of that
body alone. So the first call in rule `r`'s first `after` body is
`$$r_after_0_c0_g<k>`. The counter never repeats a value, so the correlation is unique
within the engine, and a replay takes values in the same order, so the same
recorded input yields the same correlation ([LDET.2.2]).
Any other `as` value overrides the generated form and passes through
unchanged.

**A constant per call site cross-matches concurrent activations.** Two
firings in flight at once share it, so one response satisfies both `on`
siblings, one activation's capture snapshot joins the other's response, and a
timeout sibling sees a sibling activation's answer and never fires. The
author wrote one call per activation and gets one reply per call.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__empty_corr_call_sweeps_nothing
idris.note: One reply per call: a call whose correlation is generated supersedes nothing. The generated correlation a call takes for an `as` that evaluates to "" is not modelled: the model has the empty text sweeping nothing, and the record carries it. LESS than the clause.

tla.name: lcco_3_4__GENERATED
tla.note: The calls whose correlation the engine generates, one value per firing: a call with no `as`, or whose `as` evaluates to "" (LRST.1.2). One of the two calls in every config, the one with no cooldown.

tla.name: lcrs_3_1__corr
tla.note: A generated correlation is the number of the request it is minted for: unique to the firing, as the clause's counter makes it; its form and the counter are not modelled. The sitecorr teeth engine gives such a call one value per call site, the constant the clause's third paragraph rules out.

tla.name: lrst_1_2__generated_supersedes_nothing
tla.note: One reply per call: a call whose correlation is generated retracts no answer when it fires and none when its answer arrives, since no other answer carries the firing's value. Bounded as LCRS.6.2.1's issued_call_sweeps; the sitecorr teeth engine violates it, and the generated probe shows two of the call's answers live together, one per firing.
